scope: slice 1: version-agnostic timeline view model, both projections, v1 container consuming it byte-identically, and read-only v2 rendering on the ordinary Show editor route
invariants: One view model describes the timeline; the v1 record and a ShowRecordV2 both project into it and no renderer branches on record version.
A Cut is the absence of a Transition at exact adjacency: a derived junction owns no Transition identity, never enters the Transition list, and a 1 ms gap draws nothing.
A stored zero-duration v1 Cut record is that absence; its identity survives only in an explicitly named legacy sidecar.
A whole-output Transition owns every item whose contribution meets its window, not only pairs adjacent on one Layer.
Layer identity is stable with rank zero at the bottom; Zone rows draw top to bottom by descending rank in both projections.
Layout occurrences cover the Show once, own their routing parameters, and carry their own incoming transfer.
Selection identity addresses Clips, Groups, Group Clips, Layers, Transitions, derived Cuts, Layout occurrences, Markers and Zones by their own identity, never a ShowCell inside a ShowScene.
The view model carries no Scene; every Scene concept a v1 surface still needs lives in a named legacy sidecar a v2 projection never populates.
Projection allocates no identity, writes no store, leaves both records byte-identical and repeats exactly.
A v1 record on the ordinary route projects and renders byte-identically to the pre-refactor behaviour.
A v2 record on the ordinary route is read-only: no control can change it, every item stays focusable, and no agent binding is registered, so no command sees a v2 record.
partitions: exact adjacency, 1 ms gap, stored zero-duration v1 Cut record, positive Layer Transition, whole-output Transition
record with a persisted composition, record with only flat cells requiring the projected sidecar, record with no composition at all
single Layer, Main plus named overlay Layers, materialized Group Clip uses, Zone with no Layers
Layout occurrence with and without routing parameters, repeated occurrences of one definition, incoming transfer present and absent
authored Marker, converted Scene-label chapter Marker, chapter absorbed into an existing same-name Marker
all 40 stock Shows and 7 agent baseline fixtures, including the three Layout showcases with retired silent runtime uses
sequences: convert each pinned record -> project the v1 view -> project the v2 view -> correlate by the conversion report's identity mappings -> account every difference by named cause
capture the v1 view model and rendered markup before the refactor -> switch the container to the view model -> reassert byte identity for all 47 records

seed a stored v2 record through the Worker -> open the ordinary route behind the version gate -> read timeline, Layout lane, Markers, Show End -> capture the Stage preview in Fast then Precise -> traverse by keyboard at 390 px
mutate the seam -> watch the named case fail -> restore -> watch it pass
oracles: The version-agnostic view both surfaces render, correlated by the conversion report's clipMappings, layerMappings, markerMappings and retiredSilentRuntimeUses rather than by coincidental equal text.
Committed per-record hashes of the serialized v1 view model and of the rendered markup of the timeline toolbar, ruler and grid, captured before the refactor.

The rendered accessible names and roles a reader reaches on the real route: Zone and Layer groups, Clip and Group Clip labels with their global times, the Layout occurrence label, the chapter Marker label, Show End.
Stage preview frames captured through the existing transport path in Fast and Precise over the prepared-v2 bundle.
Observed network writes and console errors during a read-only render: both zero.
redEvidence: Cut junctions: the parity run before classification showed v1 reporting authored Transitions where v2 has none, across 20 records; reading a stored v1 Cut as absence closed it.
Whole-output contributor sets: before deriving contributors from contribution rather than junction adjacency, four records reported missing contributors such as bands-the-dancer-enters-se.
Layout occurrence split: the initial run reported 1 v1 occurrence against 4 v2 occurrences for reference-property-animation and animation, which is the named Layout scalar carrier cause.
Layer names: the unified v1 projection dropped the authored overlay Layer name, so every named overlay mismatched until the projection carried it.
The read-only route spec first rendered the route's missing-Show page, because a converted row leaves the v1 list.
The e2e spec failed to load when it imported the converter, whose schema validator does not resolve under the spec runtime.
faults: Derived a Cut junction across a 1 ms gap in the v2 projection: 'leaves a 1 ms gap as blank time with no junction' failed; reverted, passed.
Read a stored zero-duration v1 Cut record as an authored Transition: 'reads a stored zero-duration v1 Cut record as the absence of a Transition' failed; reverted, passed.
Inverted the v2 Layer draw order to ascending rank: 16 corpus parity cases failed; reverted, passed.
Shifted the v1 view's Show End by one millisecond: all 48 byte-identity cases failed; reverted, passed.
Removed aria-disabled from a read-only timeline item: 'offers no mutating control and keeps every item keyboard reachable' failed; reverted, passed.
